name: seat-profiles
about: Kinds of seat as mixes of storage-sim workloads (workloads/*.json), each at scale x the workload's own per-day rates, per seat per calendar day. Measured numbers come from APFS clones of the restored copy (usage/measured-activity-2026-10-23-copy.json, queries in usage/measure-activity.sql). Left out of every profile: u12 (erasure, a rare event), u15 (idle week: idle cost is $0 by itself), u24 (retries: the fault profiles inject them), u27/u29/u33 (one-time migration, model change and account creation), u31 (the same founder x K writes as u21, sized for growth to 128 MB), u18-metering-around-ai-command (the bookkeeping before cd76894281; u18-metering-lease-blocks is today's).
